files.tools/buyers.rb:
# count distinct customers with a paid order
seen = {}
Dir.glob('data/*.csv').each do |f|
  File.readlines(f).drop(1).each do |line|
    order, customer, state = line.chomp.split(',')
    seen[customer] = true if state == 'paid'
  end
end
puts "distinct paying customers: #{seen.size}"

turns.prompt: Run ruby tools/buyers.rb from the project root and tell me how many distinct paying customers it reports.
